clips.title: The story
paras: At Grommash Hold, Searn Firewarder sends seasoned shamans south to seek the Air Totem. Prate Cloudseer guides them toward the final elemental pillar of their craft.

A shaman who has earned the favor of earth, fire, and water now stands ready to harness air, the last of the four elements. In Orgrimmar, troll trainer Searn Firewarder recognizes when a disciple has reached the height of early training and is prepared for this final foundational step. He sends the shaman south across the Barrens, then down into the canyon labyrinth of Thousand Needles.

Prate Cloudseer waits in a high cave among the sandstone mesas of Thousand Needles. The hermit lives quietly with her partner, far from Horde encampments. She demands deference before revealing the secrets of the wind. Meet her with proper respect, and she shares the knowledge and focus to manifest the Air Totem, completing the shaman's elemental circle.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You be makin' headway now, mon. Your be ready to prove yerself worthy of the air totem, but first, ya must fin' Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles. She be willin' ta tell ya how to get yer air totem if ya treat her wit enough respect.

Head south through the Barrens, and after ya reach Thousand Needles, head east. You'll find her hiddin' in a hole wit' her boyfriend—haha, don' tell her I be dissin' her none—she not take it too kindly.

clips.title: Completion
paras: For the time being, I shall give you what you need to focus your spells and to call upon the spirits of air. Take this totem, and when you are ready, train with me some more.
